title.purpose: Small headings in the security margin.

preview-editorial.purpose: Extracted Word content and editorial reading surfaces.

label.purpose: Uppercase section labels in the side fields.

motion.name: state-ease
motion.purpose: Button, border, transform, and registry-chevron state changes.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Applied to all animation and transition under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The singular high-emphasis action for choosing an authorized folder or retrying startup.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 42px; padding: 0 17px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 9px; background: var(--blue, #1d4ed8); color: #fff; font: 650 13px Inter, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 5px 16px rgba(29, 78, 216, .2); transition: background 160ms ease-out, transform 160ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #1742ba; transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #9bb4ff; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: #aeb5c8; box-shadow: none; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A restrained paper control for folder changes and recovery actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 42px; padding: 0 17px; border: 1px solid #c9c1b4; border-radius: 9px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.55); color: var(--ink, #1d211f); font: 600 13px Inter, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 160ms ease-out, border-color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #fff; border-color: #9d9589; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #9bb4ff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Workspace Select
components.description: The authorized-workspace selector in the registry.
components.css: .ds-workspace-select { width: 230px; height: 42px; padding: 0 34px 0 12px; border: 1px solid #c9c1b4; border-radius: 9px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.7); color: var(--ink, #1d211f); font: 650 13px Inter, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; } .ds-workspace-select:hover { background: #fff; } .ds-workspace-select:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #9bb4ff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Selected Registry Item
components.description: The active document row in the left-hand file registry.
components.css: .ds-registry-item { width: 230px; min-height: 34px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; padding: 5px 9px; border: 0; border-radius: 7px; background: #dfe7fb; color: #153caa; font: 650 13px Inter, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-registry-item svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.7; } .ds-registry-item:hover { background: #d4dff8; } .ds-registry-item:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #9bb4ff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Document Toolbar
components.description: The active document name with its format and size in tabular numerals.
components.css: .ds-toolbar { height: 58px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 16px; padding: 0 28px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule-soft, #e9e3d8); background: var(--paper, #fffefa); color: var(--ink, #1d211f); font: 13px Inter, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; } .ds-toolbar > strong { font-weight: 700; } .ds-toolbar > div { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; color: var(--muted, #686b66); font-size: 12px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-toolbar span { padding: 4px 7px; border: 1px solid #c8d2ed; border-radius: 6px; background: #f2f5fd; color: #284d9d; font-size: 10px; font-weight: 750; letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Text Preview
components.description: The borderless, selectable, read-only document leaf for plain text and code.
components.html:
# Notes de travail

Le document reste au centre.
components.css: .ds-text-preview { width: 520px; height: 250px; margin: 0; overflow: auto; padding: 46px clamp(36px, 7vw, 96px) 80px; white-space: pre-wrap; overflow-wrap: anywhere; background: var(--paper, #fffefa); color: #262824; font: 15px/1.72 'SFMono-Regular', Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace; tab-size: 2; }

components.name: Error Notice
components.description: A visible preview failure or file-limit message.
components.html: Impossible de prévisualiser ce fichier.
components.css: .ds-notice-error { max-width: 520px; padding: 10px 13px; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--red-soft, #f9e9e6); color: #7c2924; font: 13px/1.45 Inter, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; } .ds-notice-error:hover { background: #f6dfdb; } .ds-notice-error:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #9bb4ff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Security Verification
components.description: The green local-processing assurance in the document information margin.
components.html:
Consulté localement

DocSteward ne modifie pas le fichier et ne l’envoie à aucun service distant.
components.css: .ds-security-line { width: 250px; display: flex; gap: 11px; color: var(--muted, #686b66); font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; } .ds-security-line > span { width: 24px; height: 24px; flex: 0 0 auto; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--green, #27794c); color: #fff; } .ds-security-line svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 2.2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-security-line strong { display: block; color: var(--green, #27794c); font-size: 12px; } .ds-security-line p { margin: 6px 0 0; font-size: 11px; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-security-line:hover strong { color: #1c603b; } .ds-security-line:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #9bb4ff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: View Switcher
components.description: The compact registry control that moves between document reading and the opt-in questions-and-indicators view.
components.css: .ds-view-switcher { width: 250px; display: grid; gap: 3px; padding: 4px; border: 1px solid var(--rule, #d8d1c3); border-radius: 9px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.48); } .ds-view-switcher button { min-height: 34px; padding: 0 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #1d211f); font: 650 12px Inter, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; text-align: left; cursor: pointer; } .ds-view-switcher button:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.65); } .ds-view-switcher button.active { background: #dfe7fb; color: #153caa; } .ds-view-switcher button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #9bb4ff; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Indicator Record
components.description: A ruled saved-value record with freshness, last-success context, sources, refresh, and confirmed removal.
components.html:
À jour

Chiffre d’affaires total

22 000,00 €

Actualisé aujourd’hui à 09:42
components.css: .ds-indicator { width: 520px; padding: 20px; border: 1px solid var(--rule, #d8d1c3); background: var(--paper, #fffefa); color: var(--ink, #1d211f); font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, sans-serif; } .ds-indicator header, .ds-indicator footer { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 12px; } .ds-indicator header span { color: var(--green, #27794c); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 750; letter-spacing: .07em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-indicator header button { min-height: 34px; padding: 0 8px; border: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--muted, #686b66); font-size: 11px; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 3px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-indicator h3 { margin: 14px 0 9px; font: 600 16px/1.3 Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif; } .ds-indicator > strong { display: block; overflow: hidden; color: var(--ink, #1d211f); font-size: 34px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; letter-spacing: -.03em; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-indicator > p { margin: 8px 0 16px; color: var(--muted, #686b66); font-size: 11px; } .ds-indicator footer button { min-height: 34px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-indicator .sources { border: 0; background: transparent; color: #284d9d; font-weight: 700; } .ds-indicator .refresh { padding: 0 11px; border: 1px solid #c9c1b4; border-radius: 7px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.6); font-weight: 650; } .ds-indicator button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #9bb4ff; outline-offset: 2px; }

narrative.overview:
DocSteward is a contemporary bookbinding and colophon library: warm paper, dark ink, fine rules, and carefully placed annotations make local document consultation feel tended rather than administered. The interface is compact and editorial, but never precious. Its hierarchy serves the document first and makes read-only privacy legible at the margin.

The desktop composition behaves like an open volume with reference apparatus around it: a registry at left, the dominant document or inquiry surface in the center, and an information colophon at right. The opt-in questions-and-indicators view is another reading mode within that hierarchy, not a dashboard detached from the library. Blue is the librarian's pencil; green and red report verified system states. Controls remain recognizably desktop-native, while serif display moments and asymmetric paper silhouettes carry the identity.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper and canvas surfaces separated by hairline binding rules.
A three-part registry, document, and security-margin composition.
Georgia for editorial voice; Inter and system sans for operation; system mono for code-like text.
Annotation blue used sparingly for actions, selection, focus, active tabs, and loading state.
Opt-in document inquiry presented as cited reading, with privacy disclosure kept adjacent to the activity.
Compact behavior preserves the active reading or inquiry surface before secondary metadata.

rules.name: The Annotator's Pencil Rule
rules.body: Blue marks what can be acted on, selected, focused, or actively viewed; it does not wash entire regions for atmosphere.

rules.name: The Semantic Ink Rule
rules.body: Green and red appear only when they communicate system truth.

rules.name: The Two-Voices Rule
rules.body: Serif carries document culture; sans carries interface operation. Do not set dense controls or file trees in serif.

rules.name: The Document Wins Rule
rules.body: When width is constrained, metadata yields before the registry and active reading surface; the document or inquiry remains dominant.

rules.name: The Bound-Not-Floating Rule
rules.body: Use rules and surface tone for application structure; reserve shadow for physical paper cues and the singular primary action.

dos: Do preserve the registry–document–security hierarchy whenever width permits.
Do move essential actions with their content when a secondary panel is hidden.
Do use annotation blue for active, focused, or selected states.
Do use Georgia selectively for the bookish voice and Inter/system sans for dense operation.
Do keep focus visible and honor reduced-motion preferences.
Do express document safety as understandable state, not as decorative security theater.
Do disclose OpenAI excerpt transmission before activation and keep that disclosure visible anywhere the questions view remains available.
Do preserve citations and the last reliable value as the trust anchors for answers and indicators.
donts: Don't turn the preview into a floating card or reduce the document to a dashboard tile.
Don't introduce cool white chrome, neon accents, gradients, glass effects, or heavy drop shadows.
Don't use green or red without a real success, safety, error, or conflict meaning.
Don't introduce editing, creation, save, or destructive affordances anywhere in the document flow.
Don't present assisted search as implicit, fully local, or available without per-space consent.
Don't turn questions and indicators into an unrelated analytics dashboard; keep them within the registry–reading–security hierarchy.
Don't use a tiny text link as the only destructive target; deletion remains confirmed, explicit, and comfortably operable.
Don't over-round every region; rules and spacing are the primary structure.
